Changelog for AutoMiner v0.9.1-alpha

Release Date: August 10, 2025

This version focuses on enhancing the miner's intelligence, efficiency, and safety with several logic improvements and key bug fixes.

✨ New Features & Improvements
Intelligent Layer Generation: The miner is now smarter about efficiency! It analyzes the player's position and begins mining each new layer from the closest corner, significantly reducing initial travel time.

Advanced Vegetation Handling: Vegetation is no longer a simple obstacle. The miner can now path through replaceable plants (like tall grass) but will correctly mine them if they are on top of a solid block that is part of the mining area.

Tool Durability Protection: A new safety feature has been added to prevent tool loss. The miner now monitors the durability of the equipped tool and will automatically pause the operation if the tool is close to breaking, sending a warning to the player.

Smarter Repositioning & Stuck Recovery: The miner's problem-solving has been enhanced. It will now try simple, short movements to get into position before engaging the full pathfinder. When stuck, it will actively search for a more easily accessible block to mine instead of just skipping the problematic one.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Enchantment Compatibility: Fixed a potential crash related to how the Efficiency enchantment was retrieved, ensuring compatibility with modern Minecraft and Fabric API versions.

Configuration Command: The +automine config set pathfindingLimit command now correctly enforces its new value range of 10-10000.

Area Selection Visuals: Corrected the rendering of the selection box to ensure it perfectly matches the selected blocks and is no longer displayed as one block too large.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GoofPulseMedia/autominer/compare/alpha...0.9.1alpha

AutoMiner v0.9.0-alpha - Release Notes

Release Date: August 10, 2025

This is a major foundational update for AutoMiner, evolving it from a simple utility into an intelligent mining assistant. This alpha release introduces a persistent learning system, a full suite of keybinding controls, in-game configuration, and enhanced safety protocols.

✨ New Features
Persistent Learning & Training System: The miner now learns from its experiences! A new reward-based system remembers efficient paths and dangerous situations, saving this data to training_data.json to improve its pathfinding over time. You can also test the miner's logic in a safe, generated environment using the new Training Mode (F7).

Pause & Resume: You can now pause (F4) and resume (F5) any mining operation, giving you full control over the process without losing progress.

In-Game Configuration: A new settings screen has been added (accessible via Mod Menu) that allows you to fine-tune parameters like the Pathfinding Search Limit. These settings can also be managed via new chat commands (+automine config ...).

Keybinding-Driven Controls: The mod is now primarily controlled via a full suite of configurable keybindings for all major actions (Select, Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Cancel, Train), making it much faster and easier to use.

🔄 Improvements
Enhanced Safety Protocols: The miner is now smarter about safety. It actively detects and prioritizes breaking unstable blocks like sand and gravel that are above its target. It also recognizes fall damage and applies a learning penalty to avoid similar situations.

Client-Side Commands: All chat commands now use the + prefix to ensure they are handled locally and never sent to the server chat, preventing public spam.

UI Feedback: The mod now provides real-time status updates via the action bar (e.g., rewards gained, current status) for less intrusive feedback during operation.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed a critical crash that would occur when a user tried to open the in-game configuration screen.

❗ Known Issues
This is an alpha release. While stable, there may be undiscovered bugs or edge cases where the pathfinding may not be optimal. Please report any issues you encounter.

Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.8

Fabric Loader 0.16.14+

Fabric API 0.129.0+


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GoofPulseMedia/autominer/commits/0.9.0alpha
